title: The vendored zcbor decoder's zcbor_any_skip() in boot/zcbor/src/zcbor_decode.c descends one C-stack… (CVE-2026-16668)
description: CVE-2026-16668 is a low-severity vulnerability in the vendored zcbor decoder used by MCUboot's serial recovery command parser. The function zcbor_any_skip() recursively descends one C-stack frame per level of CBOR nesting without a depth limit, allowing an attacker to cause a stack overflow by sending deeply nested CBOR data. This occurs before any authentication and can cause the bootloader to fault or hang during recovery, resulting in a denial of service. The vulnerability requires MCUBOOT_SERIAL to be enabled and recovery entry to be accessible, which is not the default configuration. The fix involves bounding the recursion depth to prevent stack exhaustion.
